# The rest outruns the renewal

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`the-rest-outruns-the-renewal` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](the-rest-outruns-the-renewal.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where the other members alone take more than a gated renewal gives, the condition ends whatever a member takes, and with need one every reading of it after the end is alike under the member's acts: no weight of such a reading selects its restraint.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Where a part (the rest) takes from a condition jointly more than a step gives to it, the joint taking exceeds what is given, whatever any formation outside the part takes; a full taker with one other taker is the case of a part of two. (`Becoming.Flow.rest_le_taken`, `Becoming.Flow.outrun_excess`, `Becoming.Flow.excess_of_takesAll`)
2. Where renewal depends on what it renews at need m, n such steps from a level below n + m leave the level below m from then on and end every formation depending on the condition at such a need, whatever a member outside the part takes. (`Becoming.Flow.outrun_below`, `Becoming.Flow.outrun_ends`)
3. With need one, in two flows in which the rest outruns from a level at most n, every score reading the condition only from step T + n on scores the two alike, however a member's act differs between them: its restraint is invisible to such a reading. (`Becoming.Flow.outrun_reading_alike`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Balance; only active formations give; activity needs support; whatever gives to the condition depends on it at the need (the gate); the rest as a list without repetition of formations taking part where they take. Natural-number amounts, discrete steps; for the reading law, need one.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That depletion is the only equilibrium: where the rest outruns, restraint by all may also be one; which is reached is a claim about learning, tested in CG2, not a theorem.
- Anything about stochastic regrowth: the laws hold course by course; whether the rest outruns in a stochastic environment is computed (exact best responses), not proved.
- That restraint is better: the laws say where a reading cannot see it, not that seeing it is owed.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Pivotality at a threshold (Palfrey and Rosenthal 1984) read on the rest: a member is pivotal exactly where the rest alone does not cross the margin before the reading. Coordination at a known threshold (Barrett 2013; Diekert 2017); the folk theorem for stochastic games (Dutta 1995); extinction in equilibrium past a player-number threshold (Mitra and Sorger 2014); risk-dominant selection under learning (Kandori, Mailath and Rob 1993). CG2, on tabular learners in a Harvest-style commons (Perolat et al. 2017): X1_boundary_is_the_rest held; X2_end_weight_does_not_open held; X3_reading_before_the_end_opens_above_vstar held; X4_sharing_opens_only_with_renewal failed; X5_joint_reading failed.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [own-count-misses-joint-excess](own-count-misses-joint-excess.md). Reuses joint excess bounded by the level and the gate keeping a level below the need (Flow.excess_bounded_at, Flow.stays_below).
  - Output: n steps of joint excess from below n + m leave the level below m for good.
  - Input: Joint excess supplied by the rest alone, whatever a member takes.
  - Preserved conditions: Balance; the gate; givers supported. [Continuation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Continuation.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [what-taking-all-excludes](what-taking-all-excludes.md). Full taking alongside another taker (Flow.excess_of_takesAll) is now derived as the case of a part of two; the ending of dependents below the need (Flow.ends_below_at).
  - Output: A full taker with another taker exceeds what is given.
  - Input: The same, read as a part of two outrunning the renewal.
  - Preserved conditions: The two apart and taking part. [Exclusion.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Exclusion.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [the-gap-for-ones-own-act](the-gap-for-ones-own-act.md). The gap read on the rest: the member's act differs only where its reading no longer looks once the rest has ended the condition, so no selection through that reading tells its acts apart.

**Used by:** [regulation-from-one-side-and-locally](regulation-from-one-side-and-locally.md)
